text_to_image_prompt:
Adult female fashion designer with fair skin, natural soft oval face and balanced cranial height, warm brown elongated eyes, delicate straight nose, muted wine full lips, calm confident gaze, subtle beauty mark by outer eye. Long blue-black straight hair, blunt slightly arched fringe and shorter jaw-level framing sections, silver crescent moon hair clip with pale blue pearl drop. Black high-neck gathered velvet sleeveless top, delicate silver chain and moonstone pendant. Upright frontal head, level shoulders.

Create one fictional adult in premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D CG rendering, detailed individually resolved hair strands, natural delicate skin texture and crisp clothing and ornament materials. A landscape 1536x1024, 3:2 close-up head-and-upper-shoulders turnaround sheet. Three equal-width views in one horizontal row: LEFT true straight-on FRONT view with direct gaze, CENTER exact 90-degree PROFILE facing image-left, RIGHT exact 180-degree BACK view with no face visible. Same identity, hairstyle, clothing and accessory locations across all views. Camera at eye height, level upright head, neutral closed lips, matching head scale and crown levels, complete crown in frame. Pure opaque white background, soft even neutral studio lighting, natural cranial proportions. No text, labels, borders, watermarks, extra people, hands or full body.
Rear view: all long hair drapes behind the shoulders as a continuous opaque curtain covering both ears and both shoulder areas down to the lower edges; no visible ear skin or front-facing locks.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Produce ONE final three-view portrait sheet at EXACTLY 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 landscape. Input 1 is the ORIGINAL HIGH-DETAIL MASTER and primary edit target, authoritative for identity, facial geometry, colors, hair strand definition, sharpness, skin texture, clothing and ornament detail. Input 2, if supplied, is ONLY a placement guide for the previously corrected hair; do not copy its softened or degraded texture. Reconstruct directly from ORIGINAL MASTER, not by re-editing the softer guide. Match or exceed the crisp fine detail of input 1: individually resolved fine hairs, clean eyelashes and iris texture, natural skin microtexture, sharp embroidery/knit and jewelry edges, no blur, no waxy smoothing, no painterly smearing, no low-resolution upsampling, no sharpening halos or oversaturated contrast. Maintain same original semi-realistic 3D CG look. Keep the original three equal panels, left straight front, center exact left-facing side profile, right exact back, level camera, identical crop/head scale and white background. Preserve all facial identities, proportions, expressions and outfits. No text or watermarks. RIGHT BACK PANEL: all long loose hair drapes BEHIND shoulders as a continuous opaque flowing curtain. Cover BOTH shoulder/clothing/skin patches completely: below shoulder height hair reaches both panel edges, zero exposed shoulder triangles. Ears and ear jewelry fully hidden, no front/chest locks visible from behind, no bun/tie/back knot. Preserve matching hair texture, original crown width, colors and head ornaments. Use input 2 only to confirm this corrected hair placement, while rebuilding fine detail from input 1. Keep natural crown height, straight jet-black hair with sharp strand definition, original face and moon hair clip. Keep LEFT FRONT and CENTER PROFILE unchanged from the original master.
